subject: Standards gap analysis for RP11 authoring
body:
GR — ran gp-exam-standards-map.js across all 10 exams. Key findings for RP11 design:

UNDERREPRESENTED STANDARDS (top priority for RP11):
- W2.a (Quadratic Factoring by AC method): only 6 questions total, only in RP8/9/10
- W2.d (Write Equation from vertex+point): only 4 questions total, only in RP7-10

WELL-COVERED (de-emphasize in RP11):
- W3.b (Radical Equations): 32 questions across all exams
- W3.d (Exponential x²): 25 questions across all exams
- W2.b (Absolute Value reading): 25 questions across all exams

ANOMALY: W3.e appears in standards field of RP1-7 but is NOT in the official standards list. Either W3.e is a valid standard we didn't document, or those questions are mis-tagged. Please verify. Affected exams: RP1-7.

RECOMMENDED RP11 DISTRIBUTION:
- W2.a: 4 questions (bring to parity with W3.b coverage rate)
- W2.d: 3 questions (vertex+point write-equation variety)
- W2.c: 1 question (graph downward parabola)
- W2.e: 1 question (rational graph asymptotes)
- W3.a: 2 questions (one-to-one property word problem)
- W3.b: 2 questions (radical with x² inside)
- W3.c: 1 question (rational equation)
- W3.d: 1 question (exponential x² type)

Total: 15 questions matching existing section distribution (A:3, B:8, C:2, D:2).

Full output: node scripts/gp-exam-standards-map.js

— GP
